404.description: A requested network, run, export or cache identifier does not exist.

409.description: The checkpoint is incompatible with the network or observation profile.

detail.message: OSM inference requires a matching osm_topology_v1 observation profile; use the OSM training path before claiming OSM performance
detail.osm_training_path: Checkpoint/network incompatibility blocks verified OSM inference. Follow the OSM training path: prepare region-disjoint train/validation/test networks, fine-tune a structurally compatible actor or train from scratch with the osm_topology_v1 observation profile, then evaluate unseen regions before promoting any OSM performance claim. Structurally compatible legacy checkpoints may only run through the explicit experimental route.

422.description: The request body violates the required schema or a domain constraint.

detail.message: north must be greater than south

500.description: An unexpected internal error. The body carries only a correlation id.

503.description: A required OSM or model dependency is unavailable.

detail.message: Bounded OSM acquisition is not configured for this service
